about: Hand-checked truth per shot clip of the Oct 17 3pm session from the other side of the table (V2.3.3, one rack of 9-ball, balls partly shot out of order), from contact sheets of the clips. Same fields as the Oct 16 file. at = seconds into the clip when the cue ball starts moving, checked by eye (the app's own time was wrong for clips 4 and 15, and missing for 6-14). Clips 5 and 9 were never saved. Balls that dropped between clips (the 2 before clip 4, the 6 after clip 12, the 8 before clip 14) are not counted.
trackerOptsWhy: Same pocket mouths as the Oct 16 file: this outline also puts balls on the far rail at y~34-35, and balls were last seen going in at about (38.3,33.4) side and (74.8,33.8) corner.
